messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — we need to coordinate a breaking change to the Partner API auth header with marketplace vendors, HW SIs, and our SDK maintainers. Proposal: deprecate `X-Redwood-Client` header in 12w, enforce `Authorization: Redwood-v2 <token>` in 20w. Need buy-in on timelines, canary plan, and comms windows. @samir-eng you + SDK owners?
samir-eng: SG. Quick q: are we changing semantics (token format) or just header key? impacts shims for marketplace installers.
lisa-pm: Important for product — we want partners to have at least an 8w migration window + opt-in canary. Also coordinate joint announcement with marketplace listing change and release notes.
maria-partnerships: Good call. Token format stays the same, just header rename + minor handshake version tag. fallback available in dedicated mode only during grace period. we'll publish a compatibility shim in our SDKs.
samir-eng: Ok. plan: publish SDK shim that accepts old header and forwards as new one, ship patch to major SDKs in 2w, add telemetry to detect usage of old header. sample shim:
```
// pseudo
if (req.headers['x-redwood-client']) {
  req.headers['authorization'] = `Redwood-v2 ${req.headers['x-redwood-client']}`
}
```
jenna-ps: Support ops: we'll need a dedicated escalation channel and a partner-facing migration doc. can we offer 1:1 migration office hours for top 10 partners? :calendar:
tomas-legal: Flag: marketplace T&Cs mention API compatibility windows. We'll confirm if 12w is contract-compliant or if we need addendum. Also check any SI contracts that reference specific headers.
samir-eng: Canary plan: enable enforcement only for 5% of traffic in prod tenant `marketplace-canary`, monitor 7d. telemetry events: `auth.header_legacy`, `auth.header_migrated`.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to `marketplace-canary` (5%) — build 2026.03.12-rc3. Logs available: https://ci.redwood/marketplace-canary/2026.03.12-rc3 :rocket:
lisa-pm: Comms draft: publish deprecation notice to partners 8w prior, in-product banner for marketplace users at 6w, enforce at 20w. We'll do joint blog + partner emails at 10w (after major SDK patches released).
maria-partnerships: Action items: 1) SDK owners publish shim and telemetry (samir). 2) Partnerships to run partner outreach and 1:1s (maria + jenna). 3) Legal to confirm contract timing (tomas). 4) Docs + in-console banner (lisa). 5) Canary + telemetry (samir + eng-infra). I'll assemble a partner migration checklist and share by EOD. Anything else?
jenna-ps: Add rollback plan and customer support playbook. Also include escalation names + on-call rotation for migration window.
samir-eng: We'll add server-side toggle for immediate rollback, and a feature flag in console to switch enforcement per-tenant.
maria-partnerships: Perfect. I'll start outreach to top 20 marketplace vendors and HW SIs and book office hours. thanks all :thumbsup:
